precommitted_interpretation_checks: Q3 minus Q2 total revenue is +614 USD million, exactly NII +242 and noninterest income +372 in the selected company-wide table; this arithmetic does not establish their business drivers.

Reported net interest income rises +242 USD million while taxable-equivalent net interest margin falls from 2.68% to 2.61%, a -0.07 percentage-point change. Do not treat FTE margin as a GAAP dollar line or confuse percentage points with relative percent.

Net charge-offs fall -43 USD million and provision falls -324 USD million, while noninterest expense rises +467 USD million and income tax expense rises +384 USD million. Net income rises only +95 USD million; the selected lines are not a complete net-income reconciliation.

These are two adjacent quarters, not proof of a durable trend, valuation or trading conclusion. The original SEC release describes some drivers, but this selected packet does not carry source-audited causal claims.
